scope: Checked native SIMD kernels on the host Cranelift backend. General vector transport across arbitrary calls and the full API/performance matrix remain open.
implementation: Reuse checked native IR, its numeric representations, borrows, shapes, guards, masks, and structured control flow. No source-text pattern matching or new annotation.
Ten physical numeric kinds use 128-bit native registers; logical species are split into packets. Span metadata is validated once per native activation; tails are masked before memory access.

Image verification admits a closed typed subset with immutable span parameters and entry length definitions. Range analysis reconstructs dominating bounds and equal-length facts; it does not trust producer claims.
Range proofs remove complete-loop checks and redundant u32 masks. Resume entries validate live narrow integers, refresh span pointers/counts, and recheck required length equalities.

Floating intermediates defer NaN normalization only through same-kind arithmetic/comparison uses within one basic block. Stores, bitwise operations, extraction, and frame spills preserve normalization.
Vectors and rooted span owners survive budget suspension and checkpoints. Native addresses remain activation-local. Typed loops inline the existing bounded-turn budget poll.

cases: All ten native register arithmetic kinds, physical offsets, partial packets, zero active lanes, and atomic failure before stores.
Malformed operands, invalid kinds/lanes, mutable cached parameters/lengths, late length definitions, and forbidden calls.
Bounds proof mutations, nested-loop resume invalidation, equal-span proofs, and cursor narrowing.
Live vector accumulation through budget suspension, collection, whole-VM checkpoint, fresh JIT entry, and cancellation.
Changed span counts, corrupt cursor ranges, and invalid interior resume PCs fail without further stores.
NaN payloads, signed zero, infinity, and subnormal bits through deferred arithmetic and bitwise consumers.
Ten unannotated fixed-three-lane kernels, counts 0 through 19, signed and unsigned overflow including exact 64-bit values.
Unchanged simd11 explicitMap, nested-mask explicitRefine, and vector-carried explicitAlgebraic.
Authored length-guard errors, GC stress/oracle/quarantine, tasks, workers, and refusal without native compilation.

limits: Measured on this arm64 macOS host. Cross-platform AOT and Wasm remain separate gates.

The typed adapter currently accepts closed general-block scalar-span kernels. Arbitrary helpers, exact reducers, vector parameters/results, struct/SoA memory, and other expressions retain the existing native public-SIMD path.

The compiler image gains the shared native front end currently named nupp.compiler.aot.*; it does not gain an LLVM backend or AOT build driver. Moving this shared IR to a neutral namespace remains separate cleanup.
The worker fixture initializes nupp.mem.array inside each worker. Captured module values alone do not replay runtime method installation in a fresh worker.
The VM call/span boundary, residual loop instructions and required NaN normalization still cost time. This does not establish LLVM parity or the absolute overhead floor.

cleanup: Removed 13 obsolete native/host build cache generations; retained current toolchains, compiler outputs, benchmark evidence, and unmerged work. Build directory is approximately 10 GiB.

codeGeneration.observed: Two native f64x2 loads, multiplies, adds, canonical NaN selections and stores per four elements; no full-loop bounds checks, u32 masks, helper calls, or vector object materialization. The budget poll remains at the backedge.
